name: Camping 101: Cooking

angles.text: Cooking gives you the campfire that anchors an outdoor campsite. As your cooking skill grows, you can learn to build larger, sturdier fires.
As a night elf, you can learn bushcraft and firemaking from Zarrin in Dolanaar before traveling deeper into Teldrassil's wilds.

faq.answer: Cooking training introduces you to wilderness survival. A campfire anchors your campsite in the wild.
faq.q: What is the purpose of Camping 101: Cooking?

faq.answer: Zarrin teaches cooking in Dolanaar on Teldrassil. He teaches beginners culinary basics and how to build a basic campfire.
Begin by learning to build a basic campfire through cooking training. Basic training lets you make a modest camp in the wild, while further training teaches larger fires and campsite improvements.
faq.q: How do you establish a campsite in the wild?

faq.answer: Yes. Cooking gives your camp its anchoring fire, and trainers in other trades teach skilled artisans to make furnishings and improvements for their camps.
faq.q: Can you add furnishings to your campsite?

faq.answer: Cooking teaches you to build and maintain a campfire in the wild. Since fire anchors an outdoor camp, learning to cook is the first step toward wilderness camping.
faq.q: Why is cooking required for camping?

faq.answer: Yes. More cooking training teaches you to build larger fires for your wilderness camps.

sections.body: When you travel through the wild, a campfire gives you a place to begin. Seek cooking training first. Cooking lets you prepare meals from wild game and teaches you to light a basic campfire. That fire anchors an outdoor camp. Without it to ward off the chill and keep darkness at bay, you cannot make a reliable campsite in the wild.
sections.title: The Hearth of the Wild

sections.body: A basic campfire lets you make a modest camp in the wild. It holds only a few simple furnishings, but you can expand your camp as your skills grow. More cooking training teaches you to kindle larger, sturdier fires. Trainers in other trades can teach you to make furnishings and improve your camp.
sections.title: Expanding the Campsite

summary: In the wild, you begin with cooking and a fire, and trainers such as Zarrin in Dolanaar can teach you the trade. A campfire anchors your camp and opens the way to outdoor survival.
